body:
Hi @ukyo! Thank you so very much for taking the time to file this issue. This was a recent rewrite and as it gets very detailed, I had unintentionally left out the code for adding the `viewProviders` to the `AppComponent` and you found it! I've added notes in the `app.component.ts` as well as instructions in the guide. If you would like to review my PR, I'd be very grateful as you clearly have a very good eye! 

Here's the latest preview with the corrections in case you need this info right away: https://pr32501-4f0c199.ngbuilds.io/guide/hierarchical-dependency-injection#host-and-viewproviders

And the PR:
https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/32501
